tools.name: lottery_latest_numbers
tools.description: The latest Powerball and Mega Millions winning numbers: five white balls, the Powerball or Mega Ball, the Power Play multiplier and Double Play numbers, plus the next draw date. Optionally the last 2 to 10 draws. Results usually reach the feed the morning after the draw.

tools.name: lottery_numbers_by_date
tools.description: Powerball or Mega Millions winning numbers for a draw date, or every draw between two dates (up to 400 days). When no draw was held on the date, returns the draws just before and after. Powerball back to 2010, Mega Millions back to 2002.

tools.name: lottery_check_ticket
tools.description: Check a Powerball or Mega Millions ticket against the latest draw or a given draw date: which numbers matched, the prize tier, the prize amount (with Power Play, or with the multiplier printed on a Mega Millions ticket) and the odds of that tier. Optional Powerball Double Play matches.

tools.name: lottery_number_frequency
tools.description: Most and least drawn Powerball or Mega Millions numbers over the last N draws (default 100, up to all draws of the current game: Powerball since 2015-10-07, Mega Millions since 2025-04-08), with how many draws ago each number last appeared. Past frequency does not change the odds.
